title: Harness survey follow-up: a command's background processes are swept on every exit, symlinks out of the site are refused however spelled, webroot reads check the file they opened, Joomla and EmDash whole-body writes take the body guard, the comment fence sees /var/www/html, and the T4 build skill leaves Writer and SEO modes
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-subprocess-docker/test/provider.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-subprocess-docker/test/site-guards.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-webroot-read/test/symlink-fence.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/comment-fence.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/handler.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/account-subscriptions.test.mjs scripts/test/skill-catalog.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below. On Linux the race test runs; on a machine without /proc it is skipped by design.
expect: 'reap: a command that exits CLEANLY is swept as it closes' and 'reap: a command whose done REJECTS is swept too' pass.
'a symbolic link is refused however ln is spelled' and 'a language-level symlink call is refused' pass.
'openInsideWebroot: a file inside opens' passes; 'a folder flipped to the neighbour's during reads never yields the neighbour's file' passes on Linux.
'a shell write through the container's own document root is the site's file too' and 'a write: line's folder name allows that one file' pass.
The eight '🔒 D6′ Joomla' / '🔒 D6′ EmDash' body-guard tests pass.
'the per-session memory stays bounded' and 'the T4 build skill goes to the Joomla modes that change a template' pass.
fence: Each test drives the mechanism with bad input: a clean or rejected command exit, symlink commands in many spellings, a folder swapped for a link during reads, a whole-body write without a read or shorter than 80 %, a sed through /var/www/html, a write: line whose tail matches other files, 2001 sessions. No model, no network, no Postgres.

tests: reap: a command that exits CLEANLY is swept as it closes
reap: a command whose done REJECTS is swept too
a symbolic link is refused however ln is spelled
a language-level symlink call is refused
a shell write through the container's own document root is the site's file too
a write: line's folder name allows that one file
🔒 D6′ Joomla: an article introtext written whole without a read
🔒 D6′ Joomla: an introtext cut under 80 % of the read is refused
🔒 D6′ EmDash: a rich-text field cut under 80 % of the read is refused
the T4 build skill goes to the Joomla modes that change a template
